text:
evan-customer: Hey team — got an invoice (INV-2026-0421) that includes 6% DC sales tax but our billing address and primary operations are in VA. We shouldn't have DC nexus. Can you check?

jenna-support: Sorry about that — tagging @tim-billing and @maria-finance. Can you paste the invoice screenshot or PDF and the account billing address? I can start an internal ticket. :eyes:

evan-customer: attaching screenshot (sent via DM) — billing address on file is:
1234 Commerce Cir
Arlington, VA 22201
Company EIN: 12-3456789
PO: PO-8873
Invoice shows:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0421
Amount: $12,000.00
Tax (6% DC): $720.00
Total: $12,720.00
Billing addr: 1234 Commerce Cir, Arlington, VA 22201
```:confused:

tim-billing: thanks. I pulled the invoice record — system evaluated tax based on the payment method/merchant mapping. Quick check in tax service logs: 
```
[2026-03-27T10:07:12Z] tax_calc request: invoice=INV-2026-0421, account_id=acc_03X, billing_addr.state=VA, payment_method=card, card_last4=4242
[2026-03-27T10:07:12Z] jurisdiction_lookup -> matched jurisdiction=DC, rate=0.06, reason=merchant_default
[2026-03-27T10:07:12Z] tax_applied: 720.00
```
The "merchant_default" path means the account's merchant profile is mapped to the DC nexus object in our tax provider. That mapping looks stale.

maria-finance: hmm — account acc_03X was onboarded in 2024 when they had a DC office. They later closed it but we never cleared the nexus flag. We need to: 1) issue a credit for the tax, 2) update nexus flags so future invoices don't hit DC.

jenna-support: @maria-finance can you confirm next steps for credit? Customer needs refund/credit note they can apply to PO payments. Evan — do you accept a credit note + adjusted invoice or do you prefer a refund to the card?

evan-customer: credit note preferred (we need to reconcile with our PO). Refund is ok if credit note takes >7 business days.

maria-finance: we'll create a credit note (CN-2026-009) for $720 and post an adjusted invoice INV-2026-0421-R. I'll also mark the account with "nexus_override: VA_only". ETA: we can issue the CN today, refund if you need faster.

tim-billing: for the long-term fix I'll open infra ticket to remove the DC merchant mapping. Repro notes for eng: when onboarding via portal if previous nexus entries exist they were copied into new merchant profiles — need dedupe. Steps to reproduce: 1) create account with legacy office -> merchant profile gets nexus=DC 2) update billing address to VA only 3) create invoice -> tax service uses merchant mapping before billing addr override.

jenna-support: adding the ops/eng tag: @tim-billing to file ticket ENG-BILL-452 and include the above logs + SQL snippet to locate affected accounts.

tim-billing: SQL snippet I used: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, merchant_nexus, billing_addr_state FROM invoices
WHERE tax_amount > 0 AND merchant_nexus LIKE '%DC%';
```
Will run a scan and share list.

invoice-bot: Credit note CN-2026-009 created for INV-2026-0421 (credit $720). Status: pending-approval by finance.

maria-finance: approved and posted. Credit note PDF sent to billing email on file. I've updated account flags and cleared DC from merchant_nexus.

evan-customer: got the credit note PDF and updated invoice, thanks! Can you confirm this won't recur on our next billing run?

tim-billing: we've patched the merchant-mapping rule and started a scan. If we find other accounts with stale DC flags we'll clear them and issue credits case-by-case. I'll follow up with a CSV of affected accounts by EOD.

jenna-support: closing loop from support side — re-open if anything else shows up. :white_check_mark:
